# Cloud marketplace private offer PO-77812

Seller: Tallow Labs, Inc. · Buyer: Elm Biotech Corp · Start: 2026-06-01 · Term: 12 months
Contract price: $48,000.00, charged by the marketplace to the buyer's cloud bill on the
start date. Governing terms: Tallow MSA v4, accepted by the buyer in the offer. Tallow set
the price. The marketplace remits the price less its 3% listing fee within 30 days of
collection and bears no obligation to provide the software.
